# Vagrant boxes

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/vagrant.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Vagrant 2.4.9 (Linux amd64)**. Registered classes: **local, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/vagrant/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- Use the pinned Linux amd64 client; an ARM Docker host needs --platform=linux/amd64.
- A valid VirtualBox .box artifact for acme/demo 1.0.0.

Authentication: Set ATLAS_TOKEN to a runtime access/reference token. Read permission is required for metadata and box bytes; deploy permission is required for publication. Vagrant may place the token in requests, so redact query strings in diagnostics.

Fresh client state: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.

## Configure

Vagrant sends the runtime access token through its server integration. Use a new VAGRANT_HOME to avoid cached boxes.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
export VAGRANT_HOME="$AW_WORK/vagrant"
export VAGRANT_SERVER_URL="$AW_URL/artifactory/api/vagrant/$AW_REPO"
export ATLAS_TOKEN="$AW_TOKEN"
export CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1 VAGRANT_CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Vagrant repositories support local and one-node federated classes only; remote and virtual configuration is unsupported.

The .box archive must identify the matching provider. Matrix parameters define box identity even when the stored filename differs.

```sh
curl --fail --silent --show-error --header "Authorization: Bearer $AW_TOKEN" --upload-file first.box "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/boxes/first.box;box_name=acme%2Fdemo;box_provider=virtualbox;box_version=1.0.0"
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, federated**. Install from a local or one-node federated Vagrant repository.

This verifies metadata, checksums and installed box bytes; it does not boot a VM.

```sh
vagrant --no-color box add "$VAGRANT_SERVER_URL/acme/demo" --provider virtualbox --box-version 1.0.0
vagrant --no-color box list
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- No remote or virtual Vagrant repository classes.
- Installation/update proof covers box storage; virtualization-provider boot is outside acceptance.
